 LoL Worlds Match: Karmine Corp vs. T1 Preview & Betting Odds
 Cameron Kelly
 Published: 7 hours ago
 Karmine Corp and T1 are set to clash in the 2026 League of Legends Worlds quarterfinals, with a place in the semifinal at stake
 Match 
 Karmine Corp vs. T1 
 Stage 
 Knockout 
 Format 
 Best-of-Five 
 Date 
 Friday, November 6, 2026 
 Time 
 5:00 p.m. ET / 4:00 p.m. Local / 22:00 GMT 
 Venue 
 Credit Union of Texas Event Center, Allen, Texas 
 Streaming 
 LoL Esports, Twitch, YouTube 
 T1 enter as the defending LoL Worlds champions, looking to secure another trip to the finals, while Karmine Corp are aiming to continue their impressive international run. Karmine Corp finished the Swiss Stage with a 3-2 record, highlighted by an opening upset over Anyone's Legend, a 2-0 win against CTBC Flying Oyster and a 2-0 sweep of Movistar KOI in the elimination decider.
 The teams have already faced each other twice in 2026, splitting those matchups. T1 swept Karmine Corp 3-0 in the MSI Play-Ins in June, but Karmine Corp answered with a 2-1 victory in the Esports World Semifinals in July. With champion experience on one side and momentum on the other, this matchup sets up an intriguing battle as both teams hope to keep their 2026 LoL Worlds run alive.
